HERE TO HELP

QUESTIONS.

Ask us something else
Which sports does the Academy cover?

Football, futsal, basketball, hockey, touch rugby and cricket.

Does the Academy replace my school or club team?

No. The Academy is a structured programme that works alongside your existing school and club commitments.

What does the programme include?

Technical development, athletic performance, performance psychology and athlete education, with small-group development, individual planning and regular feedback.

How do I express interest in the 2027 Academy?

Email info@proteus.nz for any of our six Academy sports. Include your name and age, sport, school, and current team or club. The team will be in touch to discuss the next steps.
